messages:
maya: Quick align thread — need a single roadmap artifact for tenancy lanes, canary gates, and cross-region fallback before the PI planning review. Owners + launch criteria by Friday pls.

sam: +1. Propose a tiny policy schema: lane, residency, fallback_priority, quality_budget. Keep it executable.

jana: Customer feedback: map lanes to clear contract language (data residency, latency SLOs, reserved capacity). I'll attach three archetypes.

rolf: Ops hard requirement: block any pinned-region canary until per-tenant telemetry (p50/p95/p99, eviction-count, cache-hit) is present + runbook for automated eviction. Don't want mid-rollout pages. :grimacing:

ben: Prioritization suggestion: short matrix (impact, effort, infra-risk). I'll own scoring and share a sample sheet.

taylor: I can make a 2-slide TL;DR for the review (lanes map + gating checklist).

maya: Owners: Sam (policy DSL + examples), Rolf (telemetry + runbooks), Jana (customer mapping), Ben (prioritization). Deploy-bot, can you scaffold a central doc?

deploy-bot: created doc https://redwood.internal/docs/tenancy-lanes-playbook and branch routing/tenancy-1824689000

sam: Draft policy snippet (WIP):
```
lane: premium
residency: eu-west-1
fallback: [regional_affinity, shared_pool]
quality_budget_pct: 2
rollout: [ff_canary, ab_small, global]
```
Runtime should be able to pick quantized model variant when cost-tier requires it.

rolf: Also add pre-canary checks: telemetry completeness, KV-cache warming >50% within 3m, and capacity headroom >10%.

jana: I'll paste customer quotes in the doc and shortlist contract clauses for 'pinned region' language.

maya: Thanks — please add initial notes by EOD so I can synth for Friday review.
